archive_extract — FILEIO archive op

• Data kinds: any × text → any

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.archive_extract(data_or_path, dest, *, members=None, max_total_bytes=2147483648, max_members=100000) (to call the implementation directly, import fileio; fileio.archive_extract(data_or_path, dest, *, members=None, max_total_bytes=2147483648, max_members=100000); from the registry, opsfileio.get("archive_extract"))

Usage

Safely extract an archive into an empty destination and return relative paths.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

zip-slip(絶対path・..・drive文字)、link、特殊ファイル、重複名、10万件超、既定2 GiB超、

1:1000超の圧縮率を拒否する。dest は存在しないか空の実directoryに限り、検証済みの一時directoryを最後に置換するため失敗時に半端な出力を残さない。

Example: paths = archive_extract(payload, out_dir, members=["data/a.bin"]).
